tasks.instruction: Runway server configuration uses RUNWAYML_API_SECRET, which is not recognized by generic API-key suffix checks. Recognize it only for the canonical Runway API-key bearer Authorization scheme, both readiness and credential selection. Preserve canonical fal support, pooled grant precedence and the prohibition on falling back to environment credentials from a selected grant. Reject malformed canonical secrets before Headers can expose their value.

Native Groq and Mistral multipart transcription lacks a qualified native tariff or measured billable usage. Treat these declared transcription formats as unpriced for admission and unknown for settlement. Do not estimate their cost from ordinary token, free, foreign image, or character cards. Preserve qualified OpenAI-compatible transcription pricing and unrelated formats.

Several native operations can share one model-qualified path. Select the operation using the registered upstream model and its declared capability, not YAML order or body shape. Preserve method filtering, path decoding, original-owner lifecycle controls and existing non-overlapping routes. Reject router aliases on overlapping native paths and reject models matching multiple operations; preserve authentication before exposing selection errors.
